title: Stable-norm boundary geometry on once-punctured tori
summary: We use normal-turn estimates to study the local and global geometry of the boundaries of stable-norm balls $B_X$ for complete finite-area hyperbolic once-punctured tori $X$. We show that the boundary $\partial B_X$ is a convex-geometric detector of exponential Diophantine approximation: rational directions give genuine corners with exponentially small exterior angles, while at an irrational direction $β$ the graph-flatness order admits an explicit formula in terms of the exponential rate at which rational directions approach $β$ and the $\ell^\infty$-radius of $B_X$ in the projective…
